# BIRT report design corpus

Real Eclipse BIRT report designs (`.rptdesign`), used by `tests/engine/import-birt.test.js`: each one is imported, validated
and rendered with sample rows, and the notes are counted by kind. They are copied unchanged; the file name is the folder the
sample sits in and its file name (spaces as `_`).

Licence: Eclipse BIRT and its sample reports are published by the Eclipse Foundation and the BIRT contributors under the
[Eclipse Public License 2.0](https://github.com/eclipse-birt/birt/blob/master/LICENSE) (EPL-2.0), which permits copying
and redistributing them with the licence notice. Downloaded 2026-10-05 from
[eclipse-birt/birt](https://github.com/eclipse-birt/birt), branch `master`:

- `UI/org.eclipse.birt.report.designer.samplereports/samplereports/…` (the designer's sample reports),
- `model/org.eclipse.birt.resources/templates/…` (`templates-*`),
- `viewer/org.eclipse.birt.report.viewer/birt/…` (`birt-*`).
